name: Aurora vom Norden

facts.label: Health
facts.value: OFA Normal heart, OFA Good hips, DM and ARVC clear

facts.label: Color
facts.value: Heterozygous brindle (one brindle allele and one recessive fawn allele)

bio: Aurora is a tough, hard Boxer girl very much like her mother Jibaya.  She learns quickly and works hard, always excited about learning new things. She is very active and energetic and stays close to me always.  She's always happy, tail rarely stops wagging, body rarely stops bouncing for long.

Aurora tested as heterozygous brindle, meaning she has one allele for the dominant brindle color as well as a recessive fawn allele, so if bred to a male who also has at least one fawn allele she can have fawn offspring as well as brindle. She earned the Canine Good Citizen (CGC) title on March 21, 2026 while pregnant with her first litter by Ivo vom Hafen, is currently starting to do some Agility work, should have a Trick Dog Novice (TKN) title soon with more Agility and IPG in her future.

Aurora vom Norden, CGC was bred to Ivo vom Hafen, IPO3, FH2, Police K9 with 7 healthy brindle puppies born April 28, 2026, 5 boys and 2 girls.  Aurora's father Cliff vom Grand Kevin was a Police K9 so Police K9s on both sides of this pedigree.  I kept a female from this litter, a beautiful reverse brindle named Bellatrix vom Norden who will be bred for the first time in 2028 if she passes health testing, earns at least a CGC title and has a good, stable temperament which she certainly seems to be developing already.  The plan for 2027 spring/summer is to breed Aurora to International Champion Boaz of Covenant Working Dogs AS/BCAT/BH-VT/CSAU/DE/DMX/FN/FD/HDJ/IGP1.
